svg.title: R2DBC suspend Transaction Flow
svg.desc: Sequence diagram rebuilt from exposed-r2dbc README usage, R2dbcRepository source, and R2DBC repository tests.
svg.text: Repository calls run inside suspendTransaction, delegate to Exposed R2DBC DSL, and map ResultRow values through suspend toEntity().

g.text: map each row with suspend mapper
findById uses single(); findAll returns Flow<E>; update/delete return affected-row counts from Exposed R2DBC statements.
